text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I did everything I could to prepare for
today...
and I trained so hard... but it still
wasn't enough...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... You helped me so
much, and
yet I...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe winning is too far out of reach for

someone as mediocre as me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Then, are you giving up already?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I knew from the beginning that making
my dream
come true wasn't going to be
easy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sorry for being so whiny. I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know I keep losing, but I'm going to do
my absolute best to change that, so
please stay with
me and keep guiding
me onward!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-no! Absolutely not! I don't want to
give up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I still have a goal to achieve, so no
matter how
miserable I feel, I won't stop
running!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Strong feelings like that are anyt...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work even harder than
before. I'll do
my best to improve my
training plans as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up, so please stay with me
and guide
me onward!
